description.value: Triple Island Farm is recorded in OpenStreetMap as a restaurant and noted in discovery data as a cheese farm in the Okanagan & Thompson region of British Columbia. Beyond the OSM coordinates and tags, no verified business details are available, as the associated website has been taken over by unrelated content.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this location as a restaurant in the Okanagan & Thompson region, with discovery notes indicating a cheese farm. However, the website at tripleislandfarm.com has clearly been domain-hijacked or repurposed: it contains entirely unrelated spam content about tree trimming services in Australian cities (Morayfield, Perth, Darwin) and generic agriculture blog posts, with a footer crediting 'Garden Web' using the 'Ashe Theme by WP Royal'. No cycling amenities, business address, phone, or any BC-farm-related content can be extracted from this site. All amenity values are null because the only available source is the minimal OSM record.
concerns: Website at tripleislandfarm.com appears to be domain-hijacked or repurposed as a spam/SEO site. Content is entirely about tree trimming services in Australian cities (Morayfield, Perth, Darwin) with no relation to a BC farm or restaurant. Footer reads '© 2026 Garden Web'.
No address, phone number, or email present in OSM record.
OSM discovery notes describe a 'cheese farm' but the amenity tag is 'restaurant' — the actual nature of the business is unconfirmed.
Cannot confirm business is currently operating at this location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM record points to what appears to be a legitimate farm/restaurant in the Okanagan region, but the registered website has been hijacked and contains entirely unrelated spam content about Australian tree services. The actual business cannot be verified; a human reviewer should find current contact details or visit the location before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: A manual check (e.g., direct phone search, Google Maps, local directory) is needed to find the real website and confirm the business still operates.
